_about: Paintings for Chapters 2-9. Each prompt = base + the chapter's palette + the scene (with {theo} etc. replaced by the character descriptions). Made with Canva AI image generation, portrait 3:4, using earlier paintings as references for style and characters.
base: Hand-drawn comic panel in black ink with loose watercolour, paper-cream texture, thick ink outlines, a picture book for adults. Quiet, cinematic, lots of negative space. No text, no lettering, no words, no photorealism.

palette.2: Palette: almost entirely deep black ink and cream paper; warm lamp-yellow only where a person brings light.
palette.3: Palette: black ink, cream paper and soft pencil greys; warm lamp-yellow only where a person brings light.
palette.4: Palette: black ink, cream paper and pencil greys; faint muted watercolour colour appears only inside the warm lamp-lit areas.
palette.5: Palette: ink and cream with soft muted watercolour colours inside the warm lit areas, a little stronger; shadows stay ink-black.
palette.6: Palette: warmer gentle watercolour colours (ochre, soft brick red, sage green) in the lit areas, cream paper, ink shadows.
palette.7: Palette: muted watercolour greys and grey-greens, soft colour in lit areas; melancholic but tender.
palette.8: Palette: the storm and the dark city are black ink again, but candlelit areas glow with warm watercolour colour; dawn is pale gold and soft blue.
palette.9: Palette: FULL COLOUR loose watercolour in spring light: wisteria purple, sunny yellow, fresh leaf green, warm skin tones, joyful and bright, still with ink outlines.

characters.theo_outline: a tall slightly hunched young man with dark messy hair in an oversized hoodie, drawn ONLY as a thin pale cream outline with no fill, as if fading
characters.theo: Théo, 26, tall and slightly hunched, dark messy hair, three-day beard, oversized grey hoodie
characters.roux: Madame Roux, a tiny elderly French woman in her seventies, slippers, cardigan, reading glasses on a chain
characters.marieclo: Marie-Clo, a calm therapist in her forties with short dark hair and a soft cardigan
characters.camille: Camille, 30, Théo's older sister, short hair, a big scarf
characters.nadia: Nadia, 28, a barista with tattooed forearms, a hair wrap and a pencil behind her ear
characters.lucien: Lucien, 80, an old man in a beret with a newspaper crossword
characters.sophie: Sophie, in her fifties, in a yellow raincoat
characters.bea: Béa, 35, big and loud and kind, round glasses, a whistle around her neck
characters.yann: Yann, a shy man in his forties
characters.karim: Karim, 22, a student with headphones around his neck

warehouse: A warehouse at dawn, tall metal shelves, {theo_outline} scanning boxes with a handheld scanner. Black and grey only.
warehouse-colleague: In the warehouse, a colleague seen from behind is talking; {theo_outline} nods with a stiff smile.
radio: An old radio on a warehouse shelf; drifting from it, a few musical notes and one small heart shape drawn in cream lines.
stairwell: A bare concrete stairwell in darkness; {theo_outline} sits on the steps, folded over, arms around himself.
crying-hands: Close-up of two hands drawn as pale cream outlines covering a face, shoulders shaking, drawn with heavy wet ink strokes.
cry-room-door: A small flat at night, a closed bathroom door with a chalk mark scribble on it, a thin line of pale light under it.
bathroom-floor: {theo_outline} sitting on a small bathroom floor against the bathtub, calm now, with soft lighter lines around him.
candle-unlit: A dark kitchen table with a single unlit candle standing in the middle.
four-cards: Four cream cards fanned out on black: one shows a candle, one a cold water tap, one a little figure shaking, one a small odd creature.

cold-tap: A small sink and a cold water tap; cupped hands drawn as pale outlines splashing water onto a face.
shaking: {theo_outline} standing and shaking his whole body, arms and legs loose, with ink motion lines around him, a little funny.
creature-bear: A small sleepy creature like a heavy bear made of stone, curled up on a shelf in a dark flat, gentle and a bit sad, cream and grey.
creature-cat: A small sleepy creature like a cat made of cold fog, curled up on a shelf in a dark flat, gentle and wispy, cream and grey.
creature-eel: A small sleepy creature like a knotted eel, coiled on a shelf in a dark flat, gentle, cream and grey.

container-washed: An empty food container, washed and clean, standing alone on a dark kitchen counter.
cooking-tart: Hands drawn as pale cream outlines slicing apples and arranging them in a tart dish; the steam from a pan is drawn in warm lamp-yellow.
roux-tart: {roux} in her open doorway in warm lamp-yellow light, holding a small apple tart and delighted, the dark stairwell behind the viewer.
roux-henri: {roux} in her warm little flat pointing at a framed old photo on the wall of a man in a 1970s suit.
stairs-up: A dark stairwell going up; {theo_outline} climbing, his face touched by a warm lamp-yellow glow from below.
kitchen-two-plates: A small dark kitchen at night, two plates set on the counter, the empty space on the right; soft warm glows far in the background windows.
theo-pan: {theo}, standing alone in his kitchen holding an empty frying pan, looking lost.
map-handover: {marieclo} handing a large sheet of paper with a hand-drawn island map across a low table, warm lamp beside her.

paper-boat: A small paper boat folded from a lined sheet of paper, sitting on a dark table.
wave: A huge hand-drawn wave rising over a dark bed, drawn in pencil grey and ink, about to break.
worry-box: A small wooden box with a little clock face on its lid, on a bedside table.
city-map: A hand-drawn map of a small French river city on paper: a river, bridges, streets; one part of town on the right is in shadow.
park-fog: A park with huge old plane trees in early morning fog, the trees drawn in soft pencil grey; {theo} small, walking under them.
park-up: Looking straight up through tall plane tree branches to a big pale sky, drawn in pencil grey.
dog-running: {dog} running happily towards the viewer across a foggy park path, tongue out.
sophie: {sophie} running after {dog} in a foggy park, laughing; her yellow raincoat glows warm yellow, the only colour.
theo-dog: {theo} kneeling on a park path scratching the ears of {dog}, fog behind.
sophie-leaving: {sophie} and the three-legged dog walking away into the fog, the yellow raincoat glowing warm.
theo-window: {theo} at his dark window at night looking out over the rooftops of the city, thoughtful.
cafe-exterior: A small corner café on a cobbled street at dusk; the street is ink-black, the café window glows softly grey and warm.
cafe-interior: Inside a small café: a zinc counter, {nadia} behind it, {lucien} at a corner table with his crossword; window seats; faint warm watercolour where the lamps are.

lucien-crossword: {lucien} holding up his newspaper and pointing at a crossword clue with a pencil, looking up hopefully.
lucien-delighted: {lucien} delighted, writing in the crossword at his corner table, a warm lamp glow over him.
crossword-together: {lucien} and {theo} bent over a crossword at a café table, a warm glow over them, faint watercolour on the coffee cups.
nadia-cup: {nadia} smiling behind the zinc counter, already reaching for a coffee cup, the café window glowing warm behind.
theo-surprised: Close-up of {theo}'s face, surprised and touched, warm café light on him.
nadia-sketchbook: {nadia} leaning on the counter showing a sketchbook full of tattoo designs, including a friendly octopus.

projector-beam: An old film projector throwing a beam of light across a dark café onto a small screen.
film-lighthouse: Black-and-white old film still: a lighthouse on a rock at dusk, an old lighthouse keeper climbing spiral stairs.
film-dark-sea: Black-and-white old film still: an old lighthouse keeper staring at an empty, dark sea from the gallery.
film-unlit: Black-and-white old film still: an old keeper sitting in the dark beside an unlit lamp, a bottle on the table.
film-boats: Black-and-white old film still: a black sea at night with tiny lights far away, small fishing boats lost in the dark.
film-relit: Black-and-white old film still: the lighthouse lamp lit again, its beam sweeping out, small boats turning towards it.
film-table: Black-and-white old film still: morning on the lighthouse rock, fishermen bringing bread, fish and wine, the old keeper at a full table.
cafe-crying: In the dark café during the film, {theo} wiping his eyes; two rows ahead, {lucien} wiping his too.

nadia-flyer: Café du Pont in warm light with soft colour; {nadia} handing {theo} a flyer decorated with dice and little wooden game pieces.
theo-pocket-cards: {theo} writing short lines on small cards at his kitchen table and slipping them into his jacket pocket.
community-hall-street: Night: across a dark street, a community hall with a bright window full of people at tables; {theo} small on the opposite pavement under an unlit streetlight.
board-game-hall: Inside a community hall: four tables covered in tiny wooden game pieces, cards and dice; {bea} turning around with a big smile; warm light and soft colour.
bea-chair: {bea} beaming and pulling out a chair at a game table for the viewer, warm light.
sheep-board: Close-up of a board game with hexagon tiles of fields, little wooden sheep, wheat and bricks, warm light.
hugo-sheep: {hugo} across a game table hoarding small wooden sheep in his hands, completely deadpan.
theo-laughing: {theo} laughing out loud at a game table, surprised at himself, a warm glow and soft colour around the table.
theo-frozen: {theo} frozen at the game table, and faintly drawn behind him like a ghost, the shape of an old dream: a trophy, a guitar, a diploma and a shop sign.
hugo-handshake: {hugo} and {theo} shaking hands across a game board full of little wooden sheep, warm light.
hall-after: The community hall after the evening, drawn warm and soft: {bea} and {hugo} packing little wooden sheep into a box, talking and smiling.
kitchen-map-fridge: {theo}'s kitchen in grey-cream with some warm colour, a hand-drawn island map pinned to the fridge, the biggest landmark on it a frying pan.

phone-search: {theo} on his sofa searching on his phone; the screen glows cold blue and shows little search-result cards.
four-doors: Four cream cards on black: a magnifying glass, a signpost, a speech bubble, a seed.
roux-finger: {roux} in her warm doorway raising one finger to make a point, delighted with her idea.
note-on-door: A handwritten note taped to an old building's front door among other notices.
big-pot: {theo} cooking a huge pot of soup in his small kitchen at night, onions, carrots, a bouquet garni, steam drawn warm.

camille-smiling: {camille} on the phone in her kitchen, eyes wet, smiling, warm light.
phone-message-lisa: A phone on a kitchen counter with a message preview on its cold blue screen, everything else muted grey.
theo-still-dim: {theo} sitting very still at his kitchen table, the warm lights in the background dimmed.
box-objects: An empty cardboard box in the middle of a floor surrounded by objects: a mug, a plant, a scarf, a framed photo, a book, a hoodie, a concert ticket, a drawing.

letter-candle: {theo} at his kitchen table at night with paper and pen, one candle, muted colours.

theo-crying-soft: {theo} crying quietly, drawn with soft lines, held by warm light from the lamps around him.

theo-ladle-spring: {theo} at a big soup pot in a sunny courtyard ladling soup, glowing; {camille} watching him, proud.

marieclo-spring: {marieclo} in her office with the window open, spring light and green leaves outside.
theo-chair-spring: {theo} relaxed in an armchair in a sunny therapist's office, smiling a little.

window-sunset: {theo} reading a handwritten letter at his open window, a sunset over the colourful rooftops of the town.

empty-frame: A hand-drawn ornate empty frame filling the page, warm light spilling out of the empty space inside it.
empty-chair: A long table in a sunny courtyard, an empty chair at the end with a bowl of soup in front of it, waiting.
end-card: A single bowl of soup in full colour on a cream background, the steam rising in the shape of a little heart.
